title: A hierarchy of financial instruments
summary: The course's Forme/Cercle/Rectangle, applied to finance: an abstract Instrument with a virtual price(), concrete Bond, EuropeanOption (Black–Scholes) and Future, and a Book that values and risk-manages them polymorphically.

steps.title: Instrument and Bond
hints: `Instrument` stores the name, has a virtual destructor and `virtual double price(const Market& m) const = 0;`.
`Bond` calls `Instrument{ std::move(name) }` in its initialiser list.

steps.title: Future and a polymorphic Book
hints: `Book` stores `std::vector<Instrument*>` and quantities, and `delete`s everything in its destructor (it owns them).
Delete the copy operations: copying a Book would double-delete.
Delta by central difference: bump `m.spot` up and down by `h`.
